## Notes

- Air Reconnaissance of Land Units Table, 42.27, chart page 11 (jp2 105). Read twice, from the archive.org scan and the community chart PDFs (Shared Charts.pdf p. 11): 0 of 10 cells differ.
- One die, plus one for every four aircraft that complete the reconnaissance mission over the hex (fractions dropped). reveal is the number of battalion-equivalents the owner must reveal; null with all true means every unit in the hex, whatever its size.
